meta.ogTitle: Abdul Gaffar Shaikh — Senior Software Engineer
meta.ogDescription: 7+ years in .NET modernisation, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and production AI in high-availability financial services. Building intelligent systems at scale.

hero.name: ABDUL GAFFAR
hero.tagline: Senior engineer specialising in microservices, distributed systems, Kubernetes, and production AI — including RAG pipelines and MCP servers adopted as enterprise standards. Delivering for a global investment bank in a high-availability, high-compliance financial services environment. Based in Mumbai.

timeline.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Modernised legacy .NET applications into microservices across multiple programmes — decomposed monoliths, upgraded frameworks, and containerised services for cloud-native deployment on Kubernetes via Rancher.

Achieved zero post-deployment defects across 7 Solace event-driven messaging service migrations — resolved connection failover, message redelivery, and consumer group binding misconfigurations, independently leading 3 of the 7 migrations.

Designed and built a reusable RAG template in Python (FastAPI, LangChain, ChromaDB vector database), adopted as the account standard across 4 teams — supporting contract field extraction (50+ docs with OCR), knowledge management (4,000+ Confluence & Jira pages), tax & policy queries (100+ curated documents), and termsheet comparison.

Developed Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with JWT and Kerberos authentication, deployed as standalone services on Kubernetes via standard ingress on Rancher, enabling AI agents to securely interact with internal distributed systems and enterprise services.

Contributed to critical incident recovery during a US data centre outage at quarter-end — mobilised as part of the global SME team (India, US, EMEA) to help restore trading operations under time pressure.
Recognised by the client's Corporate CIO as a key contributor to the enterprise Knowledge Management Template — featured in the firm-wide Modernization Update (Dec 2025).
Mentors junior developers through architecture reviews and code quality standards; conducts technical interviews aligned with the client's engineering and cultural standards.
Maintains high code quality through unit testing (xUnit in .NET Core, pytest in Python) and SonarQube static analysis integrated into the CI pipeline.

Accelerates delivery using agentic AI workflows — Claude Code for architecture exploration and debugging, GitHub Copilot agent mode for coding; reduced time spent on boilerplate and investigation, freeing capacity for system design and code review.

timeline.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Led the API design and architecture for migrating legacy C# class library features to ASP.NET Core 3.1 — making key decisions on error handling patterns, microservices API structure, and compatibility with Duck Creek's configuration model for P&C insurance.
Designed and delivered a high-volume email-trigger application processing 100+ emails/day from a shared mailbox into the claims pipeline using Azure Logic Apps, Blob Storage, and REST APIs.
Documented APIs using OpenAPI specification and Swagger, making newly migrated services easier to onboard and consume across teams.
Maintained code quality and delivery velocity through GitHub version control, SonarQube analysis, and CI/CD via Azure DevOps and Jenkins.

timeline.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Collaborated with stakeholders, developers, and business analysts during agile sprints using Azure Boards on the Scrum framework for effective communication and organisation.
Implemented HTTP-triggered Azure Functions and 3 APIs to retrieve documents from the policy application and store them in the claims application.
Built a Windows-based decompiler analyser tool generating codebase metrics (override/virtual/base methods) across 40+ project solutions for development effort estimation.

Deepened understanding of the P&C insurance domain — claims lifecycle, policy structures, and Duck Creek configuration — building the domain foundation that enabled architectural ownership in the following role.

timeline.title: Associate Software Engineer
bullets: Maintained and enhanced insurance claims application across 10 monthly releases, working directly with client stakeholders.
Designed document extraction and migration tool moving 4 million claims documents from SQL Server to third-party storage systems.
Built automated document verification tool eliminating 200+ hours of manual effort for file extension validation.

impact.title: Corporate CIO Newsletter Feature
impact.body: The RAG-powered Knowledge Management solution was highlighted in the client's firm-wide Modernization Update (Dec 2025) — with the Corporate CIO personally recognising the contribution to enterprise AI adoption.

impact.title: Zero-Defect K8s Migration
impact.body: 7 messaging services migrated to Kubernetes with zero business disruption. The migration pattern established during this work became the standard approach for subsequent service migrations across the account.

impact.title: Enterprise RAG Template — 4 Teams
impact.body: What started as a single use case grew into the account-wide standard — 4 teams now build on the same RAG template for contract extraction, knowledge search across 4,000+ documents, tax & policy queries, and termsheet comparison.

skills.name: Backend Engineering
skills.desc: 7+ years in .NET Core C# with growing Python depth. REST APIs, event-driven architectures, Solace messaging, Test-Driven Development, xUnit & pytest unit testing, and SonarQube code quality analysis.

skills.name: Cloud & Kubernetes
skills.desc: Azure (API Management, Functions, DevOps) at Accenture; AWS and Kubernetes via Rancher at Capgemini. Helm chart authoring, legacy app containerisation, and zero-disruption production migrations.

skills.name: AI / RAG Systems
skills.desc: Multimodal RAG with LangChain, LangGraph, and ChromaDB. Document ingestion for PDF, Word, images, Confluence, Jira. Full OCR pipeline with pytesseract. Adopted by 4 teams in production.

skills.name: MCP & Agentic Systems
skills.desc: End-to-end Model Context Protocol (MCP) server development with JWT and Kerberos auth. Daily use of Claude Code and Copilot agent mode — early adopter building production agentic workflows with measurable delivery impact.

skills.name: Auth & Security
skills.desc: Applied across every layer of delivery — JWT bearer token authentication, Kerberos for enterprise SSO, Azure API Management gateway security, and end-to-end auth design for MCP servers.

skills.name: Technical Leadership
skills.desc: Mentoring junior developers, architecture reviews, code quality standards, technical hiring, and bridging complex engineering decisions with business needs.
